entries.text: TPC-DS OBT queries 14, 23 and 24 now run as the single-statement parts 14a/14b, 23a/23b and 24a/24b, the ids TPC-DS uses, so DataFusion no longer fails them with 'only supports a single SQL statement'; any other query that renders as several statements is split the same way and --queries 14 selects both parts.
TPC-DS OBT query 95 no longer correlates its returned-orders IN subquery with the outer query, matching the base TPC-DS query, so ClickHouse accepts it.
